title: Module 5 Current — Incident May 11–12 (RandomForest)
description:
Python RandomForest bands (30-day model), **not** peer ±2σ.

| Series | Source |
|--------|--------|
| Actual | Influx tag `machine` + `_field` |
| Upper / Lower / Expected | Influx `ml_predictions` written by the ML exporter **backfill** (`upper`, `lower`, `expected` fields) |

**Live / last ~35 days:** use your existing **History Comparison** panel (PromQL: `machine_metrics`, `last_over_time(machine_metric_*[6m])`) — same RandomForest, scraped into Prometheus.

**Older dates (e.g. May 11–12):** use this panel — Prometheus has no samples that far back; bands come from `ml_predictions` only after backfill.

Replace `Module5_Current_A` / title for other modules. Datasource = same Influx UID as working peer-band Flux panels.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.machine == "2406-176021" and
    r._field == "Module5_Current_A"
  )
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Module 5 (Actual)")

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ml_predictions")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.machine == "2406-176021" and r.field == "Module5_Current_A")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "upper")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> fill(usePrevious: true)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Upper Bound (RF)")
